notes.note: Claude adapter now passes the SDK `title` option ("Station conversation <threadId>") on new, non-resumed sessions so the engine skips its own generate_session_title model request; resumes pass none. Checked this document for claims about Claude session titles, SDK query options, adoption/continuation titles and native transcript titles; none changes. Station conversation titles, adoption matching (adoptionTitle) and rename_session behavior are unaffected, and Station reads no native Claude transcript title.
